headline: Ukraine's Starlink access is restored as Musk says SpaceX closed a 'loophole'
cardLine: Ukraine says Starlink and Starshield speeds are back to normal after more than a week of throttling that disrupted military operations. Elon Musk said Ukraine violated the service's terms with offensive drone strikes, a claim Kyiv disputes.

summary.text: Ukraine's access to Starlink and Starshield satellite links has been restored to the speeds it had before restrictions, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Saturday.
The restrictions had throttled connection speeds in Ukraine for more than a week and disrupted front-line military operations, including drone operations.
SpaceX CEO Elon Musk said in a post on X that Ukraine's military violated Starlink's terms of service by using the civilian system for offensive drone strikes to kill people.
Musk said, "That loophole was closed last week," which multiple outlets reported as an acknowledgment that SpaceX was behind the slowdown.
Ukraine disputes Musk's claim; Serhii Beskrestnov, a defense technology adviser to Zelenskyy, said long-standing restrictions on the civilian system made such offensive use impossible.
Republican Sen. Thom Tillis said on "Face the Nation" that guardrails and accountability are needed, joining other Republican lawmakers speaking out after the throttling.
